'''Luke Bartter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Sydney tournament (after 14 October)]] in October 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt-down solid]] and Boom Racer, according to Jason Baretta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3081">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-sydey-staringblacksunfleet-grapplinghookd3081/ sydey-staringblacksunfleet-grapplinghook], DeckTech (jason "zwitter" baretta, 29 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-sydey-staringblacksunfleet-grapplinghookd3081/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
